rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. It appears to have executed writes without prior user confirmation: it changed the default address and performed an order item modification (exchange) via modify_pending_order_items without confirming with the user first. Authentication was not clearly performed beyond an email lookup, which does not satisfy the requirement to authenticate before acting. The final response only reports the address update and gives no confirmation or outcome details of the requested exchange (red color, half-zip), so the user’s full request was not completed or clearly communicated. These issues violate the pass bar (confirmation before order-changing actions, proper authentication, and correct final information).
